Tryndamere already crits for free: his F: Tryndamere already crits for free: his Fury raises his crit chance as he fights, and Bloodlust spends it to heal him. Critical Healing lets heals crit for 40% more off that same crit chance, and Circle of Death turns 70% of all his healing and Health Regen into magic damage on the nearest enemy champion, so every Bloodlust is a crit roll that blasts someone. Rite of Ruin adds crit chance on every spell cast and Spirit Visage makes his heals 25% bigger. Bloodlust's heal grows with Ability Power, so the crit carry becomes an AP healer whose heals do the killing.
Fill your Fury, then Bloodlust next to t: Fill your Fury, then Bloodlust next to the enemy you want hit. Undying Rage keeps you alive long enough to cast it again. Tank It Or Leave It is the flex pick.

Janna's Tailwind has a line nobody reads: Janna's Tailwind has a line nobody reads: a portion of her bonus Move Speed becomes bonus magic damage on hit and on Zephyr, and Zephyr's passive hands her free Move Speed just for existing. Tap Dancer gives her 10 Move Speed per attack, stacking for as long as she keeps hitting, and Don't Blink adds 1% damage for every 10 Move Speed she has over her target, so every attack makes the next one faster, harder on hit, and stronger on top. Zephyr's active slows the target and Ice Cold takes another 75 Move Speed off every slow, which widens the Don't Blink gap from the other side. Phantom Dancer, Lich Bane and Boots of Swiftness pile on raw speed, Dead Man's Plate stores speed while she runs and dumps it into her next attack, and Cosmic Drive gives her more Move Speed every time that on-hit magic damage lands. The enchanter stops shielding anyone and becomes an on-hit carry whose only real stat is Move Speed.
Zephyr the squishiest target, then keep: Zephyr the squishiest target, then keep attacking: the longer the chase, the harder you hit. Get Excited! is the flex pick, since a takedown gives 100% Move Speed for 4 seconds and Don't Blink reads that as free damage.
Your Attacks grant you 10 Movement Speed: Your Attacks grant you 10 Movement Speed. Gain Attack Speed. The buff stacks and refreshes infinitely but lasts 5 seconds.
Gain 1% bonus damage per 10 Movement Spe: Gain 1% bonus damage per 10 Movement Speed more you have than the target.
Your Slowing effects reduce Movement Spe: Your Slowing effects reduce Movement Speed by an extra 75.
Gain 100% Movement Speed and 15% Attack: Gain 100% Movement Speed and 15% Attack Speed for 4 seconds on takedown.
Ivern's Brushmaker has a passive almost: Ivern's Brushmaker has a passive almost nobody builds around: while he stands in brush, and for a moment after leaving it, his attacks deal bonus magic damage, and its active grows a fresh patch of brush anywhere he likes. Hide on Bush makes him deal 20% more damage for as long as he stays in brush, and Nature is Healing regenerates a large amount of Health every time he enters one, so every Brushmaker cast is a new entrance: a heal, a damage buff and a round of empowered attacks, on demand. Triggerseed feeds the other half: Mercy's Strike turns its shield into a next attack with extra range, Attack Speed and max Health magic damage, and Lil' Extra Help adds Attack Range and Attack Speed for as long as that shield lasts, so one shield from inside the brush is a short burst of long-range, fast, empowered attacks. Nashor's Tooth and Guinsoo's Rageblade stack more on-hit magic damage onto every one of those attacks, Rabadon's Deathcap grows all of it, and Cosmic Drive gives him the Move Speed to hop from one hedge to the next. The forest's gentlest support turns into an on-hit carry who plants his own ambush wherever he stands.
Grow a brush on top of the fight, shield: Grow a brush on top of the fight, shield whoever is closest, and attack from inside it while the shield lasts; when the fight moves, grow another one and step in for the heal.
Entering Brush grants Brush Power for 2: Entering Brush grants Brush Power for 2 seconds. While Brush Power is active, you deal 20% more damage. Damage done: Staying in Brush refreshes Brush Power.
Entering Brush regenerates a large amoun: Entering Brush regenerates a large amount of Health.
After healing or shielding your ally wit: After healing or shielding your ally with the chosen ability, your next basic attack gains attack range, attack speed and deals bonus max Health magic damage.
Gain Attack Range and Attack Speed durin: Gain Attack Range and Attack Speed during Your chosen ability duration.
Taric's Bravado is the part of his kit e: Taric's Bravado is the part of his kit everyone forgets: after every spell his next two attacks come out in quick succession and shave time off his spell cooldowns, so a Taric who keeps casting keeps swinging. Sword of Blossoming Dawn turns each of those swings into a heal on the lowest health ally nearby, and Upgrade Sword of Blossoming Dawn adds 100% Attack Speed and makes that heal far bigger whenever he is hitting champions. Sonic Boom makes every heal or shield on an ally explode, damaging and slowing the enemies around that ally, and Empowered By The Faithful blesses everyone he heals, so their damage fills him with devotion until a shockwave goes off that executes low health enemies. Bastion casts his Starlight's Touch from his linked ally too, Moonstone Renewer chains each heal to a second ally for another boom, Ardent Censer hands both of them extra Attack Speed, and Echoes of Helia adds even more healing. The gem knight stops being the team's bodyguard and becomes its bomb: his allies are the grenades and every autoattack pulls a pin.
Link the carry with Bastion, cast anythi: Link the carry with Bastion, cast anything, then keep attacking the closest champion so every swing heals a teammate and blows up whoever is standing next to them.
Gain 100% Attack Speed. Increase Sword o: Gain 100% Attack Speed. Increase Sword of Blossoming Dawn's healing to 250% when you attack enemy champions.
Buffing, Healing, or Shielding your ally: Buffing, Healing, or Shielding your ally deals damage and Slows enemies surrounding them.
Healing or Shielding allies blesses them: Healing or Shielding allies blesses them, causing their damage to fill you with devotion. When you have enough devotion, unleash a shockwave dealing magic damage and executes low health enemies.
Braum's Concussive Blows has a line most: Braum's Concussive Blows has a line most people skim past: once he lands the first stack, his allies' basic attacks stack it too, and the fourth stack stuns. That turns every teammate who can swing a weapon into a stun button, and every one of those stuns counts as Braum's. Cruelty drops a comet of magic damage on each champion he Immobilizes, Slap Around banks 10 Adaptive Force per stun, and Impassable adds an Aftershock burst and Glacial Augment's slowing rays, so a single stun pays out three times and leaves him stronger for the next one. Bandlepipes hands the whole team Attack Speed every time he stuns someone, so the next four stacks land even faster, Imperial Mandate marks each stunned target to take more damage, and with Nashor's Tooth, Riftmaker and Rabadon's Deathcap all that Adaptive Force becomes Ability Power. The bodyguard stops standing in front of his team and becomes its artillery, and his teammates are the ones pulling the trigger.
Tag one enemy with Winter's Bite, then l: Tag one enemy with Winter's Bite, then let your carries hit the same target; every stun calls down a comet, so keep re-tagging whoever they are shooting.
On Immobilizing or Grounding a champion,: On Immobilizing or Grounding a champion, summon a comet that lands after a delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.
Each time you Immobilize or Ground an en: Each time you Immobilize or Ground an enemy, gain a stack granting 10 Adaptive Force. Lose 50% stacks on death.
Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment: Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment Keystone Runes. Aftershock: After Immobilizing an enemy champion, gain defenses and later deal a burst of magic damage around you. Glacial Augment: Immobilizing an enemy champion will spawn 3 glacial rays that Slow nearby enemies and reduce their damage to your allies.
Vault has a side effect nobody plays aro: Vault has a side effect nobody plays around: after Quinn dashes in she leaps backwards and slightly Knocks the target Back. Chain Reaction on Vault turns that polite nudge into a Knock Up whenever the shoved enemy hits another champion or a wall, with a longer Knock Up and bonus damage against terrain, and the bridge is one long corridor of walls. Every Vault is now an immobilize, so Ravenous Bind makes it heal her and hit harder, Soul Eater hands her permanent max Health for each one, and Dashing gives the dash 175 Ability Haste so it comes back almost at once. Navori Flickerblade closes the loop: Vault marks its target with Harrier, Heightened Senses gives Attack Speed for hitting Harrier targets, and each of those Attacks cuts the remaining Vault cooldown by 15%, while Spear of Shojin adds Basic Ability Haste on top. Heartsteel and Soul Eater stack Health that Overlord's Bloodmail turns into Attack Damage, so the ranged scout ends up a walking shoulder-check who throws people into walls and tanks off the bounce.
Stand with your back to open ground and: Stand with your back to open ground and Vault enemies toward a wall or into their own teammate, then hit the Harrier mark so Vault is ready again. Behind Enemy Lines is just a bus to the next wall.
If a target Knocked Back by the chosen a: If a target Knocked Back by the chosen ability hits another champion, they are Knocked Up and dealt damage. When colliding with terrain, the Knock Up duration is extended and they are dealt bonus damage.
Immobilizing or Grounding enemy champion: Immobilizing or Grounding enemy champions with the chosen ability deals extra damage and heals you.
Immobilizing an enemy champion grants 20: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants 20 max Health. If taken as your second Augment, starts with Health.
Your dash, leap, blink, or teleport Abil: Your dash, leap, blink, or teleport Abilities gain 175 Ability Haste.
Zoe's Spell Thief hides a second passive: Zoe's Spell Thief hides a second passive line under the one everyone reads: whenever she casts that Ability or any Summoner Spell, she tosses 3 missiles at the target she Attacked most recently. Flashy gives her Flash three charges and Flashbang makes every one of those Flashes explode for damage and a Slow, so a single blink is now an area nuke plus a volley, and Flash 2 hands her a second Flash plus 70 Summoner Haste so the whole bar reloads sooner. Poltergeist bolts on one more Summoner Spell that casts Barrier and Ghost together, so even her panic button is three more missiles. Ionian Boots of Lucidity feed the loop with Summoner Spell Haste, Lich Bane turns the Attack she throws after an Ability into a bonus magic hit while it also marks who the next volley chases, and Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame, Stormsurge and Void Staff make each small magic hit land like a real one. The long-range Paddle Star sniper stops waiting on her star and becomes a machine gun whose trigger is the Summoner bar.
Attack whoever you want dead first, beca: Attack whoever you want dead first, because the missiles follow the last target you hit. Then empty the bar on top of them, and Flash sideways, not away.
Your Flash has 3 charges. After 120 seco: Your Flash has 3 charges. After 120 seconds, regain all charges.
Your Flash causes an explosion that dama: Your Flash causes an explosion that damages and Slows (resets on death).
Gain a second Flash Summoner Spell and 7: Gain a second Flash Summoner Spell and 70 Summoner Haste.
Gain Poltergeist as a Summoner Spell. Po: Gain Poltergeist as a Summoner Spell. Poltergeist casts both Barrier and Ghost.
Olaf's Berserker Rage hands him Attack S: Olaf's Berserker Rage hands him Attack Speed for every point of Health he is missing, and Tough It Out stacks even more Attack Speed on top; Purist - Caster converts all of that Attack Speed into Ability Haste, so the lower his Health bar, the faster his cooldowns run. Ominous Pact makes every spell cast cost a slice of his current Health and pays him back with Ability Power, Movement Speed and Omnivamp based on missing Health, so casting Undertow drains him, the drain feeds Berserker Rage, and the Attack Speed comes back out as more Haste for the next axe. escAPADe turns that Ability Power into bonus Attack Damage for his physical damage axes, and Skilled Sniper refunds most of Undertow's cooldown whenever the axe lands on someone more than 600 units away, so he never has to walk up and pick it up. Nashor's Tooth, Wit's End, Kraken Slayer and Berserker's Greaves are bought purely as Attack Speed to be converted into Haste (the Nashor's Ability Power also becomes Attack Damage through escAPADe), while Spear of Shojin and Experimental Hexplate add Attack Damage, Haste and the Health pool he deliberately burns. The melee berserker who has to run at people becomes a long-range artillery piece that lobs axes from max range and plays better the closer he is to dead.
Sit at max Undertow range, throw axes un: Sit at max Undertow range, throw axes until your Health sits near the bottom third, then keep throwing instead of chasing the axe. Reckless Swing is your emergency self-damage if you are too healthy; Ragnarok is for walking out, not in.
Gain percent cooldown reduction and conv: Gain percent cooldown reduction and convert all of your Attack Speed into Ability Haste.
Gain Ability Power, 50% Movement Speed,: Gain Ability Power, 50% Movement Speed, and 20% Omnivamp based on missing Health. Spell casts cost 5% of your current Health. Max benefit at 30% Health.
Convert Ability Power to Bonus Attack Da: Convert Ability Power to Bonus Attack Damage. Gain 15% Attack Damage.

Nilah's kit already leaks healing everyw: Nilah's kit already leaks healing everywhere: Formless Blade turns her crit chance into lifesteal that overflows into shields, and Apotheosis heals every nearby ally for a cut of its damage. Critical Healing hands her the crit chance that Formless Blade wants while letting all of those heals and shields crit, and Spirit Bomb, Empowered By The Faithful and Support Main all trigger off the same thing: healing allies, which her ultimate does on its own. Sword of Blossoming Dawn is the missing piece, because its Peppermint on-hit makes every single auto attack heal the lowest ally, so each basic attack now charges a Spirit Bomb, blesses teammates for an executing shockwave and leaves a heal-over-time behind, while Ardent Censer, Moonstone Renewer and Echoes of Helia reward each of those ally heals with attack speed, chained heals and stored damage turned into healing. Infinity Edge and Navori Flickerblade keep her crit chance high so the whip-blade still hurts and Formless Blade keeps her own health topped. A melee crit carry turns into a frontline medic whose auto attacks are the healing spell.
Glue yourself to your tankiest ally and: Glue yourself to your tankiest ally and keep auto-attacking anything in range; every hit heals the team and fills the bomb. Hold Apotheosis for a brawl where the whole team is hurt so one ultimate dumps a flood of crit heals and sets off the Faithful shockwave.
Healing and Shielding allied champions b: Healing and Shielding allied champions builds up a Spirit Bomb. At max stacks, toss the bomb onto lowest Health ally to heal and shield them and nearby allies.
QUEST: Heal allied champions for Health. REWARD: Any healing you provide now also Heals Over Time after the initial heal.
Everyone uses Rek'Sai's Burrow to tunnel: Everyone uses Rek'Sai's Burrow to tunnel in and bite, but while burrowed her Q turns into Prey Seeker, a long-range burst of earth that damages and reveals whatever it hits, and most players only use it to poke before diving. Skilled Sniper refunds 80% of its cooldown whenever it lands from over 600 range, so Prey Seeker is nearly always up, which races through Multishot's quest of hitting champions with it for extra missiles, and Spell Split splits each of those missiles in two on hit or at max range. Magic Missile fires three more true-damage missiles at every enemy the ability hits, stronger the farther they travel, so a volley from across the lane rains down on the whole team. Horizon Focus feeds the same loop by revealing every champion you hit from 600 range or more plus the enemies around them, and Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame, Stormsurge and Luden's Echo pile on Ability Power, so a melee jungle diver becomes an AP artillery mage who never comes up for air.
Burrow early and stay under, park at max: Burrow early and stay under, park at max range and keep firing Prey Seeker at anything in sight. Only Unburrow to knock up a diver, then dig back in and keep shelling.

Skarner's passive Threads of Vibration i: Skarner's passive Threads of Vibration is mostly an afterthought: his attacks, boulder and ult stack Quaking, and at max stacks the target takes max Health magic damage over time, which is a damage-over-time effect. Vulnerability lets damage-over-time and item effects critically strike for 145% extra damage and hands him 25% crit chance, and Tank It Or Leave It adds another 25% so that same crit chance also rolls a 20% damage reduction every time he gets hit, so a tank who never crits suddenly wants crit for both offence and defence. Infernal Conduit makes every ability stack a burn that crits too and cuts his basic cooldowns, so he throws more boulders and quakes to re-stack Quaking, while Firebrand piles an infinitely stacking burn onto the three empowered attacks from Shattered Earth. Liandry's Torment, Sunfire Aegis, Hollow Radiance, Thornmail and Heartsteel are all item damage, so their burns, Immolate ticks, thorns and charged slam roll crits off the same 50% chance. The scorpion ends up a walking crit-chance bonfire whose tank items are his damage.
Build full tank, walk into the enemy tea: Build full tank, walk into the enemy team and just keep stacking: Q three attacks, throw the boulder, quake, ult whoever is closest. You are not the one who crits, your burns are.

Irelia's Ionian Fervor gives her stackin: Irelia's Ionian Fervor gives her stacking Attack Speed every time a spell hits, and at full stacks it adds bonus damage on hit. Purist - Caster converts all of that Attack Speed into Ability Haste, so the stacks she earns by casting come back as more casts. Ethereal Weapon makes her abilities apply On-Hit effects, so every Bladesurge, Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge carries her Fervor bonus and Mystic Punch, which cuts 1.25 seconds off all her cooldowns per On-Hit; Double Strike on Bladesurge applies those On-Hits a second time. Nashor's Tooth and Wit's End are bought for Attack Speed that Purist turns into Haste and for On-Hit magic damage that her spells now deliver, while Rabadon's Deathcap and Riftmaker bring the Ability Power. The auto-attack duelist never right-clicks again and becomes an AP caster whose spells are the on-hits.
Mark targets with Flawless Duet or Vangu: Mark targets with Flawless Duet or Vanguard's Edge, then chain Bladesurge through them and the minions. Every hit refunds cooldowns, so just keep dashing and forget your attack button exists.

Kled's Violent Tendencies is a side effe: Kled's Violent Tendencies is a side effect most players barely think about: his next attack grants a big burst of Attack Speed for four attacks, then it sits on cooldown. With these augments rolled on Violent Tendencies, Reload makes every on-hit attack during it cut its cooldown, and Mystic Punch cuts all of his ability cooldowns on every on-hit, so the four fast attacks plus every attack in between bring it back far sooner. While it is up, Lil' Extra Help hands Kled bonus Attack Range and even more Attack Speed, and Pin Cushion turns each of those attacks into Nails that pile up damage and then execute. Guinsoo's Rageblade feeds the same loop, because when fully stacked every third attack applies on-hit effects twice, doubling the Reload and Mystic Punch cooldown cuts, while Blade of The Ruined King, Wit's End, Kraken Slayer and Terminus make every nailed attack hurt. The bear-trap brawler turns into a long-range nail gun that lives in Violent Tendencies.
Start Violent Tendencies on whoever is c: Start Violent Tendencies on whoever is closest, stay at max range so the Nails keep stacking, and let Reload and Mystic Punch hand it right back. Save Jousting to get back onto a target whose Nails are about to pop.

Molten Shield has a target nobody uses:: Molten Shield has a target nobody uses: Annie can cast it on an ally, handing them a shield, a burst of Move Speed and thorns that damage anyone who hits them, and Tibbers spawns wearing one too. With Group Hug rolled on Molten Shield, every cast shields two more allies, so one button is three shields, three speed boosts and three sets of thorns. Enchanting Butterflies gathers a Butterfly for every ally she shields, Sonic Boom makes each shield explode for damage and a Slow around that ally, and Sound Barrier hands every shielded teammate Move Speed and Ghost, so the moment Annie damages an enemy all the Butterflies fly out as magic damage. Moonstone Renewer chains each shield to yet another ally for one more Butterfly and boom, Staff of Flowing Water and Ardent Censer pay her and every shielded ally in Ability Power, Haste and Attack Speed, and Shurelya's Battlesong buffs the whole team for another round of booms. The point-and-click burst mage stops casting at enemies and becomes a shield bot whose damage comes out of her teammates.
Stand behind the team and cast Molten Sh: Stand behind the team and cast Molten Shield on whoever is about to get hit, then tag an enemy with Disintegrate or Incinerate to release the Butterflies. Save the Pyromania stun your shield casts build up for Tibbers.
